input.summary: Use the top rollover and MAGIC lanes, shoot the center star target after completing MAGIC, then return up top and score the lit upper blue bumper.

quickInfo.name: Skill shot
quickInfo.summary: The skill shot crosses the top Advance and On Bumpers rollover, then enters a needed MAGIC letter lane.

quickInfo.name: MAGIC lanes
quickInfo.summary: Each MAGIC lane scores 100 points and advances the set that qualifies the center star target.

quickInfo.name: Center star
quickInfo.summary: After MAGIC is complete, the center standup awards the star and lights the upper blue bumper for 100.

quickInfo.name: Blue bumper
quickInfo.summary: The upper blue bumper becomes the main top-play scoring target after the star lights it for 100.

quickInfo.name: CITY letters
quickInfo.summary: The CITY letters qualify replay or Extra Ball awards and do not improve the normal points route.

steps.text: Plunge across the top Advance and On Bumpers rollover.
Guide the plunge into a MAGIC letter lane that is still unlit.
Send the ball back to the upper playfield instead of shooting lower targets.
Nudge above the three upper bumpers so the ball travels up one MAGIC lane and down another.
After MAGIC is complete, shoot the center standup target once to collect the star.
Return the ball to the upper playfield and score the lit blue bumper for 100.
Repeat the upper route and avoid CITY progress unless its award is enabled and useful.

fallback.title: Controlled center advance
fallback.when: Use this plan when MAGIC is incomplete and repeated upper play does not collect missing letters.

steps.text: Trap the ball before you aim at the center standup.
Shoot the target only when its miss and rebound have been safe on this machine.
Use the target to advance MAGIC toward the star.
Stop after an unsafe rebound and return to upper play.

alternatives.title: Enabled CITY award
alternatives.when: Use this plan only when the replay or Extra Ball award is enabled and useful for the current format.

steps.text: Read the CITY lamps and installed instruction card.
Use only natural CITY progress during the normal MAGIC route.
Collect the qualified award only when its shot does not replace a safer MAGIC shot.
Return to MAGIC and the lit blue bumper after the award.
Collect a missing MAGIC letter on the plunge.
Use upper-bumper nudges to collect more MAGIC lanes.
Complete MAGIC.
Shoot the center standup for the star.
Return up top and repeat the blue bumper at 100.

techniques.name: Upper-bumper lane nudge
techniques.instruction: Nudge while the ball is above the three upper bumpers. Guide it up one MAGIC lane and down another.

techniques.name: Lower-bumper restraint
techniques.instruction: When the ball moves near the lower bumper, wait to flip until the stroke can send the ball upward.

techniques.name: Center advance test
techniques.instruction: Use one controlled center-target shot to test its rebound. Continue only when the ball returns safely.

cautions.issue: Upper-bumper action can send the ball away from the needed MAGIC lanes.
cautions.response: Nudge before the ball contacts the top of a bumper. Guide it toward an unlit letter lane.

cautions.issue: The center standup can produce a dangerous miss or rebound.
cautions.response: Prefer upper play. Use the center target only for the star or a tested MAGIC advance.

cautions.issue: A poorly timed lower flipper stroke can let the ball drain under that flipper.
cautions.response: Do not flip near the lower bumper unless the stroke clearly moves the ball higher.
